name: event-photos
description: Event Photos PWA: one link, selfie search, full album, crowd uploads. Photos live in OneDrive. Node.js + TypeScript, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, React 19.

scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web && npm run test:scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && tsc -p scripts
